perception.note: Low light vision, greater electrolocation 20 feet

generalAbilities.name: Deep Breath
generalAbilities.description: The lightning turtle can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

generalAbilities.name: Greater Electrolocation
generalAbilities.description: A lightning turtle can sense minute electrical charges in living creatures, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 feet. This distance increases to 100 feet against any creature that has used an electricity effect within the last minute.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shell Shock
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A lightning turtle is hit by a melee or an unarmed attack

Effect The lightning turtle releases some of its stored electrical power, inflicting 7d6 Electricity Damage damage to the creature attacking it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Healing Pulse
offensiveAbilities.description: The lightning turtle releases a pulse of low-intensity electricity from its body to promote healing. This restores 5d8 Healing Damage Hit Points to the turtle and each living ally within 10 feet, including creatures normally immune to electricity. The turtle can't use Healing Pulse again for 1 minute and is temporarily immune to the Healing Pulse of any lightning turtle for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sparking Shell
offensiveAbilities.description: The lightning turtle withdraws into its shell. This increases its AC to 36, but it can't act except to use Shell Shock or reemerge as a single action. While in its shell, the turtle's Shell Shock deals another 4d6 damage and loses the nonlethal trait.
